appearances.headline: Google Chrome guidance moves coding agents onto modern web primitives
appearances.newly_possible: You can give a coding agent guidance so it defaults to native browser features like CSS.highlights, showModal() and field-sizing instead of old JavaScript patterns.
appearances.why: Agents that write less JavaScript and fewer dependencies produce smaller, easier to maintain front ends.
appearances.limits: No measurement yet of how much agent output actually changes.
